comments.body: Please add a dedicated description-only policy regression: assert POLICY.searchDescription === true, search for `quick-release` without a category filter, and expect exactly `['field-tripod']`. The existing combined `interviews`/`audio` case exercises description matching indirectly, but this explicit case makes the shared policy requirement visible during conflict resolution and uses the currently unused POLICY import.

Addressed in 1b7f367f13ecdc10df88db327f7a6b767c79e5b4. The new regression explicitly asserts description search remains enabled and that `quick-release` returns only field-tripod. Ten local checks and hosted run #4 pass. This response is part of the disclosed single-account review exercise.
